name: Jori En
description: Jori En is a merfolk scholar and ruin diver from Bala Ged on Zendikar, an expedition leader who helped the planeswalkers against the Eldrazi.

description_citations.text: "Jori En". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Zendikar Rising: card flavor text (Zendikar Rising, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Jori En is a merfolk scholar and ruin diver from Bala Ged on Zendikar, an expedition leader who helped the planeswalkers against the Eldrazi.

citations.text: "Jori En". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Zendikar Rising: card flavor text (Zendikar Rising, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: After the Eldrazi overran Bala Ged she fled with Kendrin, who died on the way to Sea Gate, and Jori kept his research on the leylines.

citations.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

bio.text: Gideon rescued her from Sea Gate and brought her to Jace.

citations.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

bio.text: Jace read her mind and traveled with her to the Eye of Ugin, and they were ambushed by the Eternal Pilgrims and barely escaped Ulamog.

citations.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.
"Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Jace then altered her mind so she walked back to warn Gideon that Ulamog was heading for Sea Gate.

citations.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.
"Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

bio.text: After Sea Gate fell she found the wounded Kiora and helped her recover her bident.

citations.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

bio.text: She was among the survivors of Zendikar's Last Stand.

citations.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

status.text: Jori En survived Zendikar's Last Stand and later appears on card flavor text as an expedition leader.

citations.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Zendikar Rising: card flavor text (Zendikar Rising, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon meets the merfolk Jori En carrying her dead companion Kendrin, who had been on the brink of a discovery about leylines and the Eye.
timeline.quote: Kendrin was on the brink of a discovery.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon rides an Eldrazi off the sea wall into the sea, then planeswalks to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: In a tangle of tendrils, Gideon fell with it.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon sends Jace with the soldiers to find Jori En and holds the wall alone.
timeline.quote: look for a merfolk named Jori En.

citation.text: "Slaughter at the Refuge" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace reports that Jori En never reached the camp and may be trapped in Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: He thinks Jori En was among them

citation.text: "Slaughter at the Refuge" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon sees Sea Gate's corruption from the hedron and resolves to go look for Jori En, leaving Jace to study the hedrons.
timeline.quote: And I'll find Jori En and bring her back here.

citation.text: "Slaughter at the Refuge" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: A wounded merfolk saves Nissa from walking into an Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: It was a merfolk, one clad in thick, sharp armor made of seashells.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa carries Jori En and fights with her sword, but without Zendikar's help she is pinned by an Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: She pulled on her arm with her all, but the tentacle was too heavy.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Kor on a floating rock rescue Nissa and Jori with hooked ropes.
timeline.quote: The next moment the tentacle was pulled off of her

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: A huge Eldrazi lands on the rock and Gideon appears, lashing it away with his sural and hauling everyone up.
timeline.quote: four glowing, white whips fly through the air and lash into the Eldrazi's side.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jori reunite, and he leads the survivors across floating rocks to a nearby encampment.
timeline.quote: "Jori En!" The Planeswalker cried out

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace meets Jori En, who offers her knowledge of the hedron research, and Jace reads her mind instead.
timeline.quote: "I have a better idea, if you're amenable."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace sees Jori's memories of Kendrin's team and her death to the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: She had died to the Eldrazi slaughter before she could pass on enough of what she knew.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace says they must go to the Eye of Ugin; Gideon refuses to leave the encampment and Jace reveals Nissa has left.
timeline.quote: "We already have," said Jace. "Nissa left in the night."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace and Jori set out for the Eye without Gideon and discuss whether Jace changed her mind or Gideon's.
timeline.quote: They rode out from the encampment—without Gideon.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi spawn attack Jace and Jori's coach, and the hurda panics.
timeline.quote: When the swarm of Eldrazi spawn crested the hill

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: The kor woman Ayli rescues them, killing the hurda as bait, and leads them into a chasm.
timeline.quote: sliced through the hurda's neck with one of the sharp hooks.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Ayli presents Jace and Jori as offerings to Ulamog, whom the Eternal Pilgrims worship.
timeline.quote: "Welcome, offerings, to the sanctuary," said Ayli

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace uses an illusion to make the Pilgrims believe they are on fire, and he and Jori escape.
timeline.quote: "Stop," said Jace, and the man burst into flames.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Jori someone must warn Gideon that Ulamog is heading for Sea Gate while he goes on to the Eye alone.
timeline.quote: "Go back and warn them. I'm going to the Eye."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace alters Jori's mind to make her think she chose to return, and she walks on toward Sea Gate, cursing him.
timeline.quote: "God damn it, Jace."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa, Chandra, Gideon and Jace swear an oath to stand together and form the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the Gatewatch was created.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Jori En go to the Eye, where Ugin is rebuilding the network; Jace sees the hedrons could be used to kill the Eldrazi and leaves despite Ugin's warnings.
timeline.quote: Ignoring Ugin's dire warnings, Jace left the Eye

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon recruits Jace, rescues Sea Gate survivors and retrieves Jori En, then takes command of the refugees at Sky Rock.
timeline.quote: They arrived in time to rescue several survivors from Sea Gate

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jori En warns that Ulamog is approaching Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi titan Ulamog himself was approaching Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace dominates Jori En's mind to send her back to warn the survivors of Ulamog's coming.
timeline.quote: Jace dominated Jori En's mind to force her to leave him and return to warn the survivors of Ulamog's coming.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi are driven from Sea Gate, then Jori En arrives with news that Ulamog is approaching.
timeline.quote: Then, Jori En arrived with the news that Ulamog himself was approaching ....

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Kiora gather in the lighthouse, and Jori En bursts in to warn that Ulamog is coming.
timeline.quote: "Ulamog is coming!"

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jori En bursts in with news that Ulamog is coming and that Jace delayed her return so she could warn them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog is coming!

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora volunteers to lead the offensive and demonstrates the bident by sending a wave through the window.
timeline.quote: Only the most powerful artifact on all of Zendikar

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders the army to build the trap and assigns commanders to patrols, telling them to keep Kiora from interfering.
timeline.quote: We will build the trap, and once we have secured our target, we will launch our offensive as planned.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace, guided by Jori En, meets Ugin at the Eye, learns how hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi and decides to ignore Ugin's warnings.
timeline.quote: Ignoring Ugin's dire warnings, Jace left the Eye and made his way to Sea Gate

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Jori En returns with the news that Ulamog is headed toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi titan Ulamog himself was headed towards Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora tells the tricksters Ulamog is coming and that the other planeswalkers plan to trap him, while she plans to kill or drive him away.
timeline.quote: Our plan is to kill him if we can, and drive him off if we can't,

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: The titans head to Halimar Basin; the Sea Gate survivors regroup and are joined by Kiora.
timeline.quote: The survivors of the Sea Gate effort regrouped under General Tazri

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jori En finds the wounded Kiora and they retrieve her bident.
timeline.quote: Jori En found the wounded Kiora amidst a mass of dead sea creatures.

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jori En wakes in the murky water beneath Sea Gate amid the carcasses of the sea's creatures, including a dead horned rift octopus.
timeline.quote: And it was dead.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori breaks the surface and sees Sea Gate toppled and eroded by Kozilek's blight, remembering that Ulamog was freed and Kozilek rose.
timeline.quote: The hedron network had failed. Ulamog was free.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori hears a cry for help and finds Kiora with a compound leg fracture, who says Cosi won and the bident is gone.
timeline.quote: Cosi won,

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori sets and splints Kiora's leg, and green energy heals the wound.
timeline.quote: a cluster of green motes fluttered to life around the wound.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Kiora asks Jori's help to recover the bident, which she calls their only hope, and Jori agrees to show her the way.
timeline.quote: Now we just need to recover the bident.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Following a strange current, Jori and Kiora swim into a cliff and are dragged through a rift, a Kozilek spawn guarding the way until the crevasse collapses on it.
timeline.quote: All at once, the crevasse collapsed in on itself and the Eldrazi

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: In Kozilek's reshaped caves, Kiora senses the bident beyond a ravine.
timeline.quote: The bident is that way,

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori guides a panicking Kiora through a very narrow tunnel as the bident moves ahead.
timeline.quote: Keep your eyes on me, Kiora.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori finds a chamber piled with dead Kozilek spawn and a shaft leading up.
timeline.quote: But the Eldrazi were not moving. They were all dead.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Eyeless goblins attack Jori; she kills one and stuns the others by amplifying sound.
timeline.quote: They saw with sound.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori chases the goblin carrying the bident, falls with it into a chasm, breaking ribs, and takes the bident.
timeline.quote: And Jori had Kiora's bident.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Kiora reclaims the bident and uses it to flood the caves, carrying both merfolk out on a torrent.
timeline.quote: Kiora had compelled the ocean to strip the land away.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
timeline.quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Survivors gather in the ash with no celebration, and Kiora leaves with the bident.
timeline.quote: And she didn't stop walking for a long time.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Kozilek awoke and greatly wounded Kiora; Jori En found her and they retrieved the bident.
timeline.quote: Kozilek awoke and greatly wounded Kiora.

citation.text: "Dekella", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Eldrazi overran Bala Ged, Jori En fled with Kendrin to Tazeem; Kendrin died before reaching Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: she died before she could accomplish that

citation.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon went to recruit Jace and told Jori En to join Commander Vorik's refugees.
timeline.quote: He told Jori En to join Commander Vorik's refugees so that he could find her when he returned.

citation.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon rescued Jori En from Sea Gate and brought her to Jace.
timeline.quote: He rescued her again and brought her to Jace

citation.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Jori En were ambushed by the Eternal Pilgrims and barely escaped Ulamog.
timeline.quote: the two were ambushed by the Eternal Pilgrims

citation.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Jori En split up; Jori En went back to warn Gideon.
timeline.quote: They then decided to split up

citation.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Sea Gate's destruction Jori En found and helped the wounded Kiora retrieve her bident.
timeline.quote: She found the wounded Kiora

citation.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jori En survived Zendikar's Last Stand.
timeline.quote: the titans were defeated by the Gatewatch and their allies

citation.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Rescues her and the last survivors.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

relations.note: Traveling companions whom Jace manipulates mentally.
relations.quote: Jace and Jori En exchanged another look

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

relations.quote: He rescued her again and brought her to Jace

citation.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
